title: Mr. Fleming in White Tuxedo, 1950s B&W Formal Snapshot Photo 1952
description: A sharp black and white snapshot taken on August 16, 1952, showing a gentleman identified as Mr. Fleming wearing a stylish white dinner jacket paired with a dark bowtie and dark trousers. He stands outside a brick building on a stone pathway, likely attending a summer wedding reception or formal gathering. Another man in a suit is seen stepping out of the doorway behind him.
